nouns.meaning: lòng từ bi, tổ chức từ thiện
nouns.example: The company donates a percentage of its profits to a local charity every year.
The executive chef is responsible for creating the seasonal menu.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, the outdoor concert has been rescheduled.

nouns.meaning: quyền đòi sở hữu, sự yêu cầu bồi thường
nouns.example: Please submit your insurance claim within thirty days of the accident.

nouns.meaning: người thỉnh cầu, người đòi quyền lợi
nouns.example: The claimant must provide proof of identity to receive the payment.
Our law firm represents a wide range of corporate clients.
The current economic climate makes it difficult for small businesses to thrive.
Sales agents earn a 10% commission on every product they sell.
The organizing committee is meeting to plan the annual gala.

nouns.meaning: người đi lại thường xuyên (bằng vé tháng)
nouns.example: The new express train service will greatly benefit daily commuters.
He recently joined a tech company specializing in artificial intelligence.

nouns.meaning: sự đền bù, vật bồi thường
nouns.example: The workers are demanding fair compensation for their overtime hours.
To stay ahead of our competitors, we must focus on innovation.

nouns.meaning: lời than phiền, đơn khiếu nại
nouns.example: The customer service department handled a formal complaint regarding the faulty item.

adjectives.example: Although the materials were cheap, the finished product looks very professional.
Ensure that the new software is compatible with your existing operating system.

adjectives.meaning: có khả năng, đủ trình độ
adjectives.example: The company is looking for a competent manager to lead the new branch.

adjectives.meaning: có tính cạnh tranh, giá cả phải chăng
adjectives.example: We offer high-quality services at very competitive prices.
A complete list of participants will be available on the website tomorrow.

verbs.meaning: đăng ký phòng, làm thủ tục vé
verbs.example: Passengers are advised to check in at least two hours before departure.
Guests must check out of their rooms by 11:00 AM.
You can claim your lost baggage at the information desk.
We need to classify these documents according to their importance.
The construction of the new office building is scheduled to commence in July.

verbs.meaning: di chuyển đều đặn (đi làm/đi học)
verbs.example: He has to commute for over an hour each day to get to the office.
It is always wise to compare prices before making a major purchase.
The airline will compensate passengers for the long delay.
Residents often complain about the noise from the nearby construction site.

adverbs.example: This type of software is commonly used in graphic design offices.
